intel.title: [CISA KEV] Perforce Puppet Enterprise - Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-115731
廠商: Perforce
產品: Puppet Enterprise
漏洞名稱: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
說明: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-12-01
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 通報 Perforce Puppet Enterprise 存在未信任資料反序列化漏洞（CVE-2026-115731），允許攻擊者透過提交特製報告在 Puppet Server 上執行任意程式碼。經比對公司資產清冊，本公司並未引進或部署 Puppet Enterprise 相關軟體系統。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
